data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts that sustained flags are justified by 'cross-critic consistency across independently seeded falsificationist stances (SRC_007, SRC_009)' — yet the target itself lists zero commitments ('commitments: (none)'). Under §11.3 the adjudication ritual requires sustained flags to be bound to adjudicative commitments that can be checked; pointing to agreement between two other critics is a rhetorical appeal to consensus, not the commitment-grounded justification the ritual standard demands. The target therefore explains the wrong thing: it argues 'other critics agree' instead of stating the ritual commitment under which the flags are sustained.
